resources.string: Bind to UI Tree Service
Allows binding to the Agent UI Tree Service to read structured interface information.
Bind to Screen Capture Service
Allows binding to the Agent Screen Capture Service to obtain screen frames.
Manage Notifications for Agent
Allows reading, filtering, clearing, and replying to notifications on behalf of the Agent.
Subscribe to System Event Stream
Allows subscribing to system-wide event stream including notifications, foreground changes, telephony, and other system events. Restricted to platform-signed applications.
Bind to Action Execution Service
Allows binding to the Agent Action Execution Service to submit and monitor action requests.
Bind to Agent Runtime Service
Allows binding to the Agent Control Block (ACB) Service for agent registration, state management, and capability tokens.
Bind to Memory Service
Allows binding to the Agent Memory Service to store and retrieve agent memories.
Bind to Audit Service
Allows binding to the Agent Audit Service to record and verify audit events.
Query Semantic Entities
Allows querying the semantic entity ontology and knowledge graph.
Bind to Context Service
Allows binding to the Agent Context Service to subscribe to context frames.
Bind to Policy Engine
Allows binding to the Policy Engine for capability token issuance and policy evaluation.
Bind to Asset Library
Allows binding to the Agent Asset Library to register and query skills, DMI, and macros.
Bind to Inference Router
Allows binding to the Inference Router Service for model routing decisions.
Manage Agent Sandbox
Allows managing agent sandbox instances for third-party agents.
Bind to CallGate Service
Allows binding to the CallGate Service for call classification and interception.
Bind to MotionHub Service
Allows binding to the MotionHub Service for gesture and posture detection.
Bind Agent UI Interface
Allows SystemUI to bind to Agent brain for UI command channel. Restricted to system UI process.
Provide Agent Session Service
Allows Agent brain application to provide session service to SystemUI. Restricted to platform-signed brain application.
